subject: Film & Cinema
title: AI and the Future of Screenwriting
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on AI and the Future of Screenwriting.

hook.text: AI can now generate a screenplay in minutes. The question is whether anyone should use it.

buildup.text: Studios see AI as a cost-cutting tool. Writers see it as an existential threat.

discovery.text: The 2023 strike won protections: AI can't receive credit or replace human writers.

twist.text: AI can mimic structure and tropes but struggles with surprise, irony, and lived experience.

climax.text: The tools will keep improving. The fight over who gets to use them has just begun.

punchline.text: Machines write scripts. Humans write stories.

quiz.question: What did the 2023 WGA strike achieve regarding AI?
options: AI was banned from all studios
AI cannot receive writing credit or replace human writers
